LESSON: DOMESTIC VIOLENCE

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Muamalat (Social Relations)
Topic 6.1: Domestic violence

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Domestic violence. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Domestic violence
2. Practise Domestic violence at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Domestic violence

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Domestic violence
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Domestic violence. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Domestic violence at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Domestic violence at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Domestic violence
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Domestic violence. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Domestic violence using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Domestic violence in the examples.
2. Explain Domestic violence to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Domestic violence.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Domestic violence using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Domestic violence important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Domestic violence
2. Practise Domestic violence at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Domestic violence

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
